cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

mechanism: A treats a worried bride as its former counter trainee, using old reassurance routines to withhold the location and then the phone contact for her dress.
confusable: Not merely a helpful clerk: A invokes shared training to get B to accept less practical information with more personal comfort.
comparison: School consequence worry versus professional familiarity under wedding pressure.
